items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Little Walter. Right from Memphis. Right from under the jug band. That's us in place. All of them. They ain't got nothing on us.

ctx.x: Well, I played with Charlie Pierce. He played violin. Red Robey. Red Robey played guitar. And the little boy we used to have here, I mean, stuff. He played guitar. All those fellas. And Shaky Head Walter. He played harmonica. Little Walter. Played with Muddy Walter now. We teached him around here. He played his harmonica.
